summary: Verified the admin slider modal + upload fix in GenericCrud.jsx. Full end-to-end flow validated on preview URL: (1) modal STAYS OPEN after native file picker closes (fixed via mouseDown+click on backdrop pattern), (2) instant blob preview appears immediately with spinner overlay, (3) upload success updates img to /api/uploads/slides/{name}.png and 'Image téléchargée' toast is shown, (4) Save persists the slide with the uploaded image URL (verified via GET /api/public/slides), (5) uploaded image serves 200 OK with content-type image/png, (6) new slide appears on the public home hero slider, (7) backdrop-click intentionally closes the modal, (8) client-side validation rejects .txt files with upload-error banner + toast and keeps modal open, (9) same fix confirmed on /admin/temoignages. Cleanup done (TEST slide deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In ImageUploader, once uploaded, displaySrc prefers previewUrl (blob) over server value while modal is open. Cosmetic only — server URL is correctly persisted on save. Consider revoking blob after successful upload and switching to server URL so the admin can visually confirm the actual stored image before saving.
Recharts console warnings on Dashboard: width/height(-1) container — unrelated to this fix but present.
